description: Half length portrait of Alfred Stieglitz squinting in the sun, holding his  glasses and a floppy white hat in his lap; he is seated  in a chair in front of  a white clapboard house with shutters ( his family house in Lake George); he wears a long sleeve cardigan sweater with a matching sweater vest and and open collared white shirt; his hair blows in the breeze and his head is turned toward viewer with his face in partial shadow.
title: Alfred Stieglitz
